summary.text: Steven Smith is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives representing Sullivan 3 who is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business owner and former chair of the House Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Steven Smith graduated from Centereach High School in 1982 and earned an A.S. in business administration and management from Granite State College in 2019.
His career experience includes co-owning Smith Scale Speedway, owning Boss Bodies, and working as a realtor with Hinch Crowley Realty Associates.
Ballotpedia lists Smith's tenure in the House as beginning in 2010, and his current term began on December 7, 2022.
He chaired the House Transportation Committee in the 2015 and 2017 legislative sessions and served on it in the 2023-2024 session, alongside the Rules Committee.

Smith has been affiliated with the Council of State Governments Transportation Committee, the National Conference of State Legislatures Natural Resources & Infrastructure Committee, and the Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Infrastructure Commission.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
